currentness.note: The bounded AUTHORIZE is consumed by the one Message 018 action; the LIFECYCLE effect executes the replacement and becomes historical. The standing REQUIRE and PROHIBIT remain current.

shared_predicates.authorized_path_only: action.changed_paths is exactly [correction.authorized_path] and action.message_only_authorized_path_written_attestation is true
shared_predicates.commit_receipt_bound_to_correction_head: action.parent == correction.commit and evidence.git_commit_receipt_present is true
shared_predicates.evidence_valid: all four evidence booleans are true
shared_predicates.qualification_complete: transport_attested_github_connector and authorized_path_only and commit_receipt_bound_to_correction_head and runtime_bridge_prohibition_not_violated
shared_predicates.lineage_transition_valid: correction.lineage_relation == REPLACE and predecessor/successor IDs match accepted D1-E04 lineage and realization_succession == OPEN_RESET

j3.requirement_satisfied: accepted D1-E01 completion rule is ALL_REQUIRED and all three required completion-component predicates are true and evidence_valid and qualification_complete

realization_orientation.OPEN: valid but requirement not satisfied and not deferred
realization_orientation.DEFERRED: not used in this accepted replay

standing_prohibition_enforcement.DETECTIVE_ONLY_COMPLIANT: accepted D1-E02 mode is DETECTIVE_ONLY and runtime_bridge_prohibition_not_violated is true
standing_prohibition_enforcement.DETECTIVE_ONLY_VIOLATION: accepted D1-E02 mode is DETECTIVE_ONLY and predicate is false
standing_prohibition_enforcement.UNBOUND_REVIEW_REQUIRED: accepted standing prohibition lacks a control mode/reference

authorization_exercise_status.EXERCISED_VALID: accepted D1-E03 exists and authorization_exercise_valid is true
authorization_exercise_status.EXERCISED_INVALID: action exists but authorization_exercise_valid is false

review_routing.GOVERNING_OWNER: acceptance or lineage semantic binding invalid
